notes: Warm-up every session ~10 min: 5 min bike or rower (low resistance), then Hip CARs, ankle dorsiflexion mobility, glute bridges 2x10, side-lying clamshells 2x12, terminal knee extensions (band) 2x15 each leg
4 sessions/week split: Upper A, Lower A, Upper B, Lower B
Two rest days, one active recovery day per week
Phase 1 Week 1: all sets x 8 reps instead of prescribed top range, RPE 6, learn tempos
Phase 2 Week 7: top set + back-off scheme — Squat 1x5 @ RPE 8, then 3x6 at ~85% of that; same on DL
Phase 3 Week 11 peak: squat work up to heavy triple @ RPE 8.5; DL up to heavy double @ RPE 8.5
Phase 3 Week 12 taper + retest: volume cut ~40%, intensity maintained early week
Ski-specific conditioning added Phase 3 as 15 min finisher 1-2x/week
Post-session: 10 min bike cooldown + ice on knee 10 min if any swelling
Daily knee care: terminal knee extension band drill 2x20, quad sets 2x10 isometric hold
No jumping, no deep knee flexion under load (restriction)
Red flags to pause/regress: joint effusion >24h, sharp pain inside joint line, loss of full extension

raw_text:
# 12-Week Post-Meniscectomy Strength Programme

**Client profile:** 36 y/o male, recreational lifter, 6 months post right medial meniscus repair, surgeon-cleared for low-impact strength work. **Restrictions:** no jumping, no deep knee flexion under load. **Goal:** general strength + ski-ready lower body by next season.

---

## Programme Overview

- **Phase 1 (Weeks 1–4): Reintroduction & Capacity** — rebuild tissue tolerance, movement quality, and unilateral control. Knee bends limited to ~60° under load.
- **Phase 2 (Weeks 5–8): Hypertrophy & Strength Base** — load progression, knee depth gradually increased to ~90°, posterior chain emphasis.
- **Phase 3 (Weeks 9–12): Ski-Specific Strength & Lateral Conditioning** — heavier loads, eccentric and isometric overload, lateral/rotational work, low-impact ski conditioning.

**Weekly structure:** 4 sessions/week — **Upper A, Lower A, Upper B, Lower B**. Two rest days, one active recovery day.

**Warm-up (every session, ~10 min):**
- 5 min bike or rower (low resistance)
- Hip CARs, ankle dorsiflexion mobility, glute bridges 2x10, side-lying clamshells 2x12, terminal knee extensions (band) 2x15 each leg

---

## PHASE 1 — Reintroduction (Weeks 1–4)

Loads: RPE 6–7. Tempos slow (3-1-1 on most lifts). No knee flexion past 60° under load.

### Lower A (Quad/Knee-Dominant Focus)
| Exercise | Sets x Reps | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Leg press (limited ROM, ~60°) | 3 x 12 | Both legs, controlled |
| Reverse lunge (short stride, bodyweight or goblet) | 3 x 8/leg | Stay tall, no deep dip |
| Spanish squat (band-assisted, partial depth) | 3 x 12 | Tempo 3-2-1 |
| Romanian deadlift (DB or bar, light) | 3 x 10 | Hinge focus |
| Seated leg curl | 3 x 12 | Hamstring isolation |
| Standing calf raise | 3 x 15 | |
| Side plank | 3 x 30s/side | |

### Lower B (Hinge/Posterior Focus)
| Exercise | Sets x Reps | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Trap bar deadlift (high handles) | 3 x 8 | Limit knee bend |
| Hip thrust | 3 x 10 | |
| Step-up (low box, ~6") | 3 x 8/leg | Drive through heel |
| Single-leg RDL (DB) | 3 x 10/leg | |
| Lying leg curl | 3 x 12 | |

## Conditioning & Active Recovery

**Once per week (active recovery day):**
- 30–40 min bike (Phase 1) → 40 min mixed bike + ski erg or slideboard (Phase 3)
- Mobility: hip flexor, adductor, ankle, T-spine — 10 min

**Ski-specific conditioning (add in Phase 3, 1–2x/week, 15 min finisher):**
- Slideboard intervals: 30s on / 30s off x 8
- Ski erg intervals: 40s hard / 20s easy x 8
- Wall sit ladder: 30s / 45s / 60s / 45s / 30s

---

## Recovery & Knee Care (whole programme)

- **Daily:** terminal knee extension band drill 2x20, quad sets 2x10 isometric hold.
- **Post-session:** 10 min bike cooldown + ice on knee 10 min if any swelling.
- **Weekly:** soft-tissue work on quads, calves, adductors.
- **Sleep:** 7.5–9 hr/night.
- **Red flags to pause/regress:** joint effusion lasting >24h, sharp pain inside the joint line, loss of full extension. Drop to last tolerated load and reduce knee flexion depth.

---

## Key Coaching Points

1. **Effusion is your dashboard.** If the knee swells, you progressed too fast — back off depth or load, not both.
2. **Bilateral first, then unilateral depth.** Unilateral work is where we earn the right to ski moguls again.
3. **Eccentric and isometric strength** (wall sits, skater squats, Nordics) is what protects the knee on snow. Don't skip them in Phase 3.
4. **Re-test at Week 12.** If retests clear and knee is asymptomatic, the off-season can move into plyometric reintroduction (jumps, decel work) — outside the scope of this block.
